data.narrative:
PILGRIM is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Jake Adler, having raised $4.3M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 10 peers—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—selected for sector and stage relevance.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses the $4.3M raised as a proxy valuation base and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying $11M. Peer-median analysis across 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $700M, with a range spanning $125M (NODA AI, Series A) to $4.0B (Stark Defence, Series A). The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in stage, funding history, and market position within Defense & Security.

The triangulated range is $9M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $355M. Stage-progression yields the floor; peer-median yields the ceiling. Key uncertainties include PILGRIM's differentiation within a crowded frontier-defense market, path to revenue, and capital efficiency relative to better-funded competitors. The wide spread reflects genuine ambiguity: early-stage Defense & Security valuations remain highly sensitive to technology validation, regulatory tailwinds, and customer concentration.
